# sockseek

[sockseek](https://github.com/fiso64/sockseek) is the Soulseek batch downloader that `tandem download` drives.

`sockseek.exe` lives in this folder but is not tracked by git (it is larger than GitHub's 100 MB file limit).

- Installed version: **3.0.5** (`win-x64`)
- Check it: `vendor\sockseek\sockseek.exe --version`

## Restoring or upgrading the binary

1. Download `sockseek_<version>_win-x64.zip` from https://github.com/fiso64/sockseek/releases
2. Extract `sockseek.exe` into this folder, replacing the existing one.
3. Run `tandem config` to confirm it is detected, then update the version noted above.
